note: Claim ledger for spark-membrane. Labels classify claim types; they are not a score. Statements touching fenced topics are refused by spark_membrane/claims.py and may not appear here.

claims.label: public_dataset_negative
claims.statement: On the locked NASA SMAP/MSL protocol, OES32 did not meet its pre-stated success criterion: it beat only EWMA on SMAP, and maxabs and CUSUM scored a higher pooled F1 (not significantly).

claims.label: synthetic_negative
claims.statement: On the oes-telemetry-bench SYNTHETIC held-out set, max-abs matched OES32's detections (6/7 each) with fewer false-alarm episodes per normal hour (11.54 vs 23.08); the rates come from about 5 minutes of synthetic normal time and are highly uncertain.

claims.label: synthetic_negative
claims.statement: The multi-quantum-oes preregistered SYNTHETIC stress evaluation found no demonstrated advantage: the block score did not beat a simple max-abs baseline.

claims.label: unrun
claims.statement: oes32-hls FPGA synthesis is UNRUN; its latency figure is a design target, not a measurement.

claims.label: unrun
claims.statement: The qldpc_decoder_cpp HLS kernel has no belief-propagation updates yet; its HLS synthesis and hardware-in-the-loop runs are UNRUN.

claims.label: external_inspiration
claims.statement: The split into an exploratory proposer and a zero-entropy auditor is an external dual-engine inspiration. The pinned OES repositories do not implement it; the explorer in this repository is new code.
claims.source: external: design conversation (Grok chat) shared by the author; oes32-residual and oes32_engine contain no proposer

claims.label: synthetic_result
claims.statement: REPAIRED_IN_SIM means only that one capped single-index edit of a SYNTHETIC frame passes the T=0 audit in simulation; nothing is repaired or written anywhere.

claims.label: boundary
claims.statement: spark-membrane is a classical software simulation on generated numbers. It is not a medical device, not control software, not sensor fusion and not field evidence, and it makes no quantum, QEC, consciousness, medical or gravity claims.

claims.label: boundary
claims.statement: signal-loom is linked as an art skin only; none of its streams enter the audit.
